body: CURRENT CODEC SEAM, read-only evidence for S1-S3. `StoryModelCodec` canonically serializes the semantic model and only its optional core `BuildReceipt`; status is phantom and deliberately not written. The richer `ExtendedBuildReceipt` (stage records plus layer coverage), `ResolutionState`, and `CandidateLedger` live in `acquire`. The `codec` module already depends on `acquire`, but defines no canonical codecs for those acquisition-account types. This makes the two-role artifact decision structural rather than cosmetic: do not stuff acquisition history into StoryModelCodec and do not turn manifest.json into a second semantic envelope. Add a versioned result/outcome codec around a deliberately closed output account, while storymodel.json remains byte-for-byte under StoryModelCodec. One more dependency boundary must be explicit: `ViewBasis` and renderer-neutral scene types live in `view`, but `codec` does not currently depend on `view`; a manifest/report packet containing typed basis or projection state therefore needs either an intentional codec -> view edge or a narrowly owned bundle-codec module. Never downgrade those fields to strings merely to avoid stating the edge. Also, serializing generic CandidateLedger[A] wholesale is not yet a spec: the result schema must declare which claim/value families it admits and how their typed payloads are encoded.
